steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then Lanta Old Town pier and a light breakfast.
The speedboat leaves for Koh Rok.
A short snorkelling lesson, then the first snorkelling stop and time for photos.
Thai buffet lunch on the beach of Koh Rok, where monitor lizards live.
Time on the beach: swimming, sunbathing or snorkelling from the shore.
Koh Haa and a third snorkelling stop in the lagoon.
The speedboat leaves Koh Haa for Koh Lanta, then the transfer to your hotel by car or by boat.

day.title: How the day goes (later trip, back at sunset)

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel by private car.
The boat leaves Koh Lanta for Koh Rok, with snacks on the way.
The first snorkelling stop at Koh Rok: coral reefs and tropical fish.
Thai buffet lunch on the beach, then time to swim, sunbathe or snorkel from the shore.
Sunset cruise back to Koh Lanta with soft drinks on board, then the transfer to your hotel.

beforeYouBook.pickup: Pickup at your hotel around 08:00, light breakfast at Lanta Old Town pier.
bring: Cash for the national park fee
beforeYouBook.weather: Mid-October to mid-May. The national park closes Koh Rok and Koh Haa from 16 May for the monsoon.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Join-in speedboat and the later sunset trip: tell us at least 12 hours before departure, or the full price is charged. Private longtail: we confirm the conditions with you when you book.

faq.q: When can you go to Koh Rok?
faq.a: From mid-October to mid-May. The national park closes Koh Rok and Koh Haa from 16 May for the monsoon.

faq.q: How long is the boat ride to Koh Rok?
faq.a: About an hour and a half by longtail. The speedboat is faster.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child from 4 to 11 in cash to the ranger on Koh Rok. Children under 4 do not pay.
The join-in trip is by speedboat and includes Koh Haa. The private longtail goes to Koh Rok only, at your own pace.

legacyText.title: Koh Rok & Koh Haa Day Trip | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Koh Rok is two islands, Koh Rok Nok and Koh Rok Nai, about an hour and a half south of Koh Lanta by longtail and less by speedboat. Koh Haa, the Five Islands, has a turquoise lagoon for the last snorkeling stop on the way back.
The park is closed in the rainy season. Tours run from October to April.
legacyText.cardDescription: Snorkeling around the islands of the Mu Ko Lanta National Park.
goodToKnow: Private longtail option: Koh Rok only, 8:00 to 16:00, about 1h30 each way, your group only.
Private speedboat option: your group only, 9:00 to 16:00.
A later version with a sunset stop also exists on some days. Ask us.
Children from 4 to 11 pay a child rate on the speedboat.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The national park fee is paid on the island and is not included.
legacyText.parkFee: 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child
